name: Mexico CURP Checksum
description: Validates Mexican CURP identifiers (18 characters). Characters map to their index in the official dictionary '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNÑOPQRSTUVWXYZ' (note Ñ occupies 24, shifting O-Z up by one); the first 17 values are weighted 18 down to 2 and the final digit must equal (10 - sum mod 10) mod 10.
